candidates.source_name: Magyar Közlöny (Magyarország hivatalos lapja) — official gazette portal
candidates.why_relevant: The constitutionally authoritative point of promulgation for every Hungarian törvény, kormányrendelet, miniszteri rendelet and MNB rendelet. Any statutory obligation or transposition deadline affecting banks and PSPs becomes binding only on publication here, and the issue date drives hatálybalépés (entry-into-force) arithmetic. Authentic digitally signed PDFs since 3 May 2013.
candidates.access_status: open, free, no login; issue listing paginated via ?year=&page=N and ?serial=N
candidates.legal_status: public official publication; Hungarian public-sector information
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily poll of the issue index (https://magyarkozlony.hu/?year=&page=1), download each new issue PDF, OCR-free text extraction, then regex the table of contents for 'hitelintézet', 'pénzforgalm', 'pénzügyi szolgáltat', 'fizetési', 'MNB rendelet'; extract hatálybalépés dates from the záró rendelkezések.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from search result pagination patterns
queries_used: magyarkozlony.hu Magyar Közlöny lapszámok letöltés hivatalos lap
Magyar Közlöny hitelintézeti törvény módosítás pénzforgalmi szolgáltatás
Hivatalos Értesítő magyarkozlony.hu kozlonyok.hu közlönyök gyűjteménye

candidates.source_name: Hivatalos Értesítő (companion gazette to Magyar Közlöny)
candidates.why_relevant: Carries non-jogszabály official acts — ministerial utasítások, közlemények, notices, appointments, and administrative announcements that frequently set operational deadlines for supervised financial institutions even though they are not statutes. Published on the same portal as Magyar Közlöny, so it is easy to miss if only the main gazette is monitored.
candidates.access_status: open, free, same portal, separate serial stream
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Same crawler as Magyar Közlöny but selecting the Hivatalos Értesítő serial stream; classify by issuing ministry (NGM/PM) and by keyword.
queries_used: Hivatalos Értesítő magyarkozlony.hu kozlonyok.hu közlönyök gyűjteménye

candidates.source_name: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár (NJT) — official consolidated law database
candidates.why_relevant: The state-operated free consolidated ('hatályos', 'időállapot') text database run by MKIFK Magyar Közlönykiadó és Igazságügyi Fordítóközpont Zrt. Gives the point-in-time consolidated version of Hpt., Pft., Mnbtv., and every MNB/Korm./miniszteri rendelet, with colour-coded status (in force / repealed / not yet in force) and effective-date ranges — exactly the structure a compliance calendar needs. Also hosts indokolások (explanatory memoranda), international treaties, and English translations.
candidates.access_status: open, free, no login for reading; registration only for change-monitoring/bookmarks; no documented public API or bulk export
candidates.legal_status: official government service; free-access statutory database
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Stable per-act URL pattern (e.g. /jogszabaly/2013-237-00-00, /jogszabaly/2017-35-20-2C) — maintain a watchlist of act IDs for Hpt., Pft., Mnbtv., Pmt., MNB payment decrees and diff the consolidated text between időállapotok; use the 'hatályba lépő / hatályát vesztő jogszabályok' date views for forward-looking deadlines.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + direct fetch of the portal homepage to map features and URL patterns
queries_used: njt.hu Nemzeti Jogszabálytár pénzforgalom lebonyolítása MNB rendelet hatályos
Nemzeti Jogszabálytár Hpt. módosító törvény határidő

candidates.source_name: NJT indokolástár (repository of statutory explanatory memoranda)
candidates.why_relevant: Indokolás (explanatory memorandum) texts state legislative intent and, crucially for A3, name the EU directive being transposed and the reasoning behind chosen transition periods. This is where a compliance calendar gets the 'why' and the EU linkage for a Hungarian deadline.
candidates.access_status: open, free
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword search on 'hitelintézet', 'pénzforgalom', 'pénzügyi szolgáltatás'; link each indokolás back to the parent act ID collected from NJT/Magyar Közlöny.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from NJT homepage feature map and from a 57/2022 MNB rendelet indokolás hit in search
queries_used: njt.hu Nemzeti Jogszabálytár pénzforgalom lebonyolítása MNB rendelet hatályos

candidates.source_name: Hpt. — 2013. évi CCXXXVII. törvény a hitelintézetekről és a pénzügyi vállalkozásokról (Credit Institutions Act), consolidated
candidates.why_relevant: The core prudential statute for Hungarian banks — licensing, own funds, governance, outsourcing, disclosure, sanctions. Almost every CRD/CRR-package transposition and every domestic banking obligation lands as an Hpt. amendment, so tracking Hpt. módosítások is the single highest-yield statutory tracker for the banking half of the cell.
candidates.access_status: open on NJT and on net.jogtar.hu; also mirrored at mkogy.jogtar.hu
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Pin the act ID and diff consolidated időállapotok on a weekly cadence; parse the 'Záró rendelkezések' and 'Az Európai Unió jogának való megfelelés' sections for entry-into-force dates and directive references.
queries_used: Magyar Közlöny hitelintézeti törvény módosítás pénzforgalmi szolgáltatás

candidates.source_name: Pft. — 2009. évi LXXXV. törvény a pénzforgalmi szolgáltatás nyújtásáról (Payment Services Act), consolidated
candidates.why_relevant: The Hungarian payment-services act — the PSD2 transposition vehicle and the statute defining pénzforgalmi szolgáltató categories, SCA-adjacent duties, liability and information obligations. It is the act that PSD3 will amend or replace, so it is the anchor document for the payments half of the cell and for any PSD3 transposition deadline.
candidates.access_status: open, free (net.jogtar.hu free tier); also on NJT
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track the NJT consolidated version as the authoritative copy; diff on each amendment promulgated in Magyar Közlöny; watch specifically for a PSD3 transposition amendment.
queries_used: Magyar Közlöny hitelintézeti törvény módosítás pénzforgalmi szolgáltatás

candidates.source_name: 35/2017. (XII. 14.) MNB rendelet a pénzforgalom lebonyolításáról (Payment Execution Decree)
candidates.why_relevant: The operational rulebook for executing payments in Hungary — instant payment (azonnali átutalás) rules, execution deadlines, value limits, request-to-pay, secondary account identifiers. It is amended frequently (e.g. 57/2022. (XII. 22.), 41/2024. (VIII. 29.)) and each amendment carries hard implementation dates that banks and PSPs must build to. Highest-value single decree in the cell for payments compliance dates.
candidates.access_status: open, free
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Pin the NJT act ID and diff időállapotok; separately capture each módosító MNB rendelet as promulgated in Magyar Közlöny and extract its staged hatálybalépés table.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball to amending decrees
queries_used: njt.hu Nemzeti Jogszabálytár pénzforgalom lebonyolítása MNB rendelet hatályos
MNB rendeletek jegybanki rendelet mnb.hu jogszabályok pénzforgalom hatályos

candidates.source_name: Mnbtv. — 2013. évi CXXXIX. törvény a Magyar Nemzeti Bankról (MNB Act)
candidates.why_relevant: Defines the MNB's rule-making and supervisory powers, including the legal basis and procedural limits for MNB rendeletek and supervisory sanctions. Needed to interpret which supervisory instruments are legally binding versus soft guidance — a recurring classification problem for a compliance calendar.
candidates.access_status: open, free
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency snapshot (quarterly) via NJT/net.jogtar consolidated text; alert on amendment.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from MNB regulation search results
queries_used: MNB rendeletek jegybanki rendelet mnb.hu jogszabályok pénzforgalom hatályos

candidates.source_name: MNB rendeletek index (mnb.hu central bank decrees listing)
candidates.why_relevant: The issuer's own chronological index of every MNB rendelet, including reporting-obligation decrees (adatszolgáltatási MNB rendeletek) and payment decrees. Faster and better-structured than gazette scraping for detecting a new MNB rendelet, and it links straight to the binding text. Pointer because it indexes rather than promulgates.
candidates.access_status: open, free
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly scrape of the index page; diff against a stored list of decree numbers; for each new decree resolve the NJT consolidated URL and the Magyar Közlöny issue.
queries_used: MNB rendeletek jegybanki rendelet mnb.hu jogszabályok pénzforgalom hatályos

candidates.source_name: MNB — Jogszabályok / Egyéb magyar jogszabályok (supervised-institution law index)
candidates.why_relevant: The supervisor's curated index of all Hungarian legislation applicable to supervised institutions, excluding MNB decrees (which sit in a sibling submenu). This is effectively an authoritative shortlist of which acts and decrees the regulator itself considers in scope for banks and PSPs — an excellent seed set for a statutory watchlist.
candidates.access_status: open, free
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly scrape to refresh the statutory watchlist; treat additions/removals as a signal that scope changed.
queries_used: MNB rendeletek jegybanki rendelet mnb.hu jogszabályok pénzforgalom hatályos

candidates.source_name: MNB Pénzforgalom — Szabályozás (payments regulation hub)
candidates.why_relevant: The MNB's payments-domain regulatory landing page, bundling the payment decrees, the Pft., and the relevant EU acts in one place with issuer commentary. Useful for confirming which instruments govern a given payment obligation and for catching announcements of forthcoming decree amendments.
candidates.access_status: open, free
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly scrape; extract outbound links to jogszabály texts and to consultation documents.
queries_used: MNB rendeletek jegybanki rendelet mnb.hu jogszabályok pénzforgalom hatályos

candidates.source_name: Wolters Kluwer net.jogtar.hu — Hatályos Jogszabályok Gyűjteménye (free tier)
candidates.why_relevant: The commercially-maintained free consolidated database of Hungarian law in force, with the most stable and widely-cited deep-link scheme (docid=a1300237.tv). Valuable as a cross-check against NJT: divergence between the two consolidations is itself a signal of a recent or contested amendment. Free tier gives text in force plus the next upcoming időállapot.
candidates.access_status: free tier open without login; registration and paid Jogtár tiers unlock history, annotations and change monitoring
candidates.legal_status: commercial publisher; ToS restrictions likely apply to systematic scraping — check impresszum/ToS before automating
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use deep links for human verification and low-volume checks only; do not bulk-scrape. Prefer NJT for automated collection and use net.jogtar as a manual cross-check.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + repeated appearance across seed-query results
queries_used: net.jogtar.hu Hatályos Jogszabályok Gyűjteménye ingyenes Wolters Kluwer Jogtár

candidates.source_name: mkogy.jogtar.hu — Törvények és országgyűlési határozatok (Parliament-facing statute database)
candidates.why_relevant: Parliament's Jogtár-powered collection of acts and parliamentary resolutions, including historical acts (e.g. the superseded 1996. évi CXII. Hpt.) and newly adopted amendment acts such as 2025. évi C. törvény a pénzügyi közvetítőrendszert érintő törvények módosításáról. Useful for lineage tracing — what an obligation looked like before an amendment.
candidates.access_status: open, free
candidates.suggested_collection_method: On-demand deep-link retrieval by docid when historical text or an omnibus amendment act needs to be resolved.

candidates.source_name: Országgyűlés — Folyamatban lévő törvényjavaslatok / Irományok (bills in progress)
candidates.why_relevant: Bills (T/xxxxx irományok) are visible here weeks before promulgation in Magyar Közlöny, giving the earliest hard signal of a coming statutory deadline. Financial-sector omnibus bills — e.g. 2025. évi C. törvény on amendments to acts affecting the financial intermediary system, and the 2026 financial-sector harmonisation bills — pass through this pipeline together with committee (TAB) amendment papers.
candidates.access_status: bill listing open; the advanced 'Irományok lekérdezése' query interface appeared to require authentication in search results — treat as partially gated, unverified
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the pending-bills list weekly; fetch iromány PDFs at https://www.parlament.hu/irom42/{num}/{num}.pdf; keyword-filter titles for 'pénzügyi', 'hitelintézet', 'pénzforgalm', 'jogharmonizáció'; then follow the same iromány number until promulgation.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball to iromány URL pattern

candidates.access_status: open document download; URL pattern per session (…_2026-osz)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch twice yearly (spring/autumn session start), parse the annex table of planned bills, and seed the compliance calendar with expected-submission months for finance-related items.

Gives both the draft binding text and a concrete consultation deadline — directly on-topic for the 'consultations' and 'deadlines' topics of this run.

candidates.why_relevant: The EU-side register of which Hungarian statutes Member State authorities have formally notified as transposing a given directive, updated weekly. negative_findings.description: Neither Nemzeti Jogszabálytár (njt.jog.gov.hu) nor magyarkozlony.hu documents a public API, bulk download, or open-data export. NJT's homepage lists search, topic filters, ABC lists and registration-based change monitoring, but no machine interface. Magyar Közlöny is distributed as digitally signed PDFs behind opaque hashed download paths.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection must be built on HTML scraping of stable per-act URL patterns plus PDF text extraction; no official structured feed exists for either binding-text source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines the engineering shape and fragility of the whole A3 statutory pipeline for Hungary, and means URL-pattern drift is the main long-term breakage risk.

negative_findings.description: Searched in English for a Hungary-specific PSD3/PSR transposition plan, draft amendment to the Pft., or announced national deadline. All retrieved material was EU-level law-firm and vendor commentary on the EU timeline (plenary vote expected late May 2026, OJ publication mid-2026, PSR application ~21 months later, PSD3 transposition into 2027–2028).
negative_findings.result_summary: No Hungarian national PSD3 transposition instrument, draft, or announced deadline was found in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: PSD3 is the largest pending payments obligation for HU PSPs; the absence of any national signal so far means the first detection will come from the Kormány törvényalkotási programja or a kormany.hu draft consultation, and those two must be monitored specifically for it.

negative_findings.description: Search results indicated that parlament.hu's advanced 'Irományok lekérdezése' query interface may require authentication, while the plain 'Folyamatban lévő törvényjavaslatok' listing and direct iromány PDF paths (parlament.hu/irom42/{n}/{n}.pdf) appear openly reachable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as a hypothesis, not a verdict — no fetch was performed against the query form, so the gate is unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If the structured query form is gated, bill monitoring must rely on listing scraping plus predictable PDF paths, which is workable but less precise for filtering by subject.

negative_findings.description: net.jogtar.hu (Wolters Kluwer) and adt.arcanum.com are commercial platforms whose terms of service for systematic automated retrieval were not read in this pass, though both were reachable in search and net.jogtar.hu offers an open free tier.
negative_findings.result_summary: Reuse/scraping permissions for the two commercial consolidations remain unestablished.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The automated pipeline should be built on the state-run NJT (explicitly a free public service) and use commercial databases only for manual cross-checks, to avoid a ToS problem.

negative_findings.description: NJT advertises a translations section (/forditasok, /translations), but no evidence was found in this pass that consolidated Hungarian financial-sector statutes (Hpt., Pft., MNB payment decrees) are maintained in authoritative, up-to-date English.
negative_findings.result_summary: Binding-text coverage for this cell is effectively Hungarian-only; English material found was secondary commentary.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any downstream consumer working in English will depend on machine translation of the Hungarian binding text, with the accuracy risk that carries for dates and obligations.

coverage_gaps.description: Several statutes that clearly belong in the watchlist were identified by name but not resolved to a specific NJT act ID in this pass: Pmt. (AML/CFT act), the consumer-credit act (Fhtv./Hitel tv.), the deposit-insurance provisions (OBA), and the ministerial decrees on fizetési számla váltás and on the pénzforgalmi szolgáltatók adatszolgáltatása.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a targeted NJT keyword pass ('pénzmosás', 'fogyasztónak nyújtott hitel', 'betétbiztosítás', 'fizetési számla váltás') to pin exact act IDs and add them to the diffing watchlist.

coverage_gaps.description: The current Hungarian ministry responsible for financial-sector rule-making (Nemzetgazdasági Minisztérium / earlier Pénzügyminisztérium) was only reached indirectly through kormany.hu Dokumentumtár filters; its own decree and consultation pages, and the current tarsadalmiegyeztetes@ mailbox domain, were not confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map the current ministry's own site section for jogszabálytervezetek, confirm the ministry filter ID on kormany.hu/dokumentumtar, and verify the live consultation mailbox.

coverage_gaps.description: NJT offers registration-based change monitoring and bookmarks, but whether those produce an email or RSS feed usable for automated alerting was not established; no RSS/Atom feed was identified on magyarkozlony.hu either.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Create an NJT account and test the változásfigyelés feature end to end; probe magyarkozlony.hu and mnb.hu for undocumented RSS endpoints before committing to pure polling.

coverage_gaps.description: Alkotmánybíróság and Kúria decisions can strike down or reinterpret binding financial-sector provisions and thereby move or void deadlines, but no source for those was scouted in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add alkotmanybirosag.hu and kuria-birosag.hu (plus their Magyar Közlöny-published AB határozatok) as a follow-up scouting target, or confirm they belong to a different coverage cell.

coverage_gaps.description: EUR-Lex NIM was identified as the EU-to-HU transposition bridge, but the specific CELEX list of directives in scope for HU banks and PSPs (CRD, PSD2/PSD3, CCD2, AMLD, DORA-adjacent, IFD) was not compiled.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the in-scope CELEX watchlist and wire each to its EUR-Lex NIM tab filtered to Hungary, so a missing HU notification past a transposition date raises an alert automatically.

brief: Hungary's binding-text layer for banking and payments is unusually clean: everything becomes law only on promulgation in Magyar Közlöny (magyarkozlony.hu, authentic signed PDFs), and the state-run Nemzeti Jogszabálytár (njt.jog.gov.hu) provides free point-in-time consolidated texts with explicit in-force/repealed/not-yet-in-force status — together these two cover essentially all hard dates the cell needs, anchored on Hpt. (2013. évi CCXXXVII. tv.), Pft. (2009. évi LXXXV. tv.), Mnbtv., and the MNB payment decrees led by 35/2017. (XII. 14.) MNB rendelet. Early warning comes from three upstream channels — the Government's semi-annual törvényalkotási program, parliamentary irományok on parlament.hu, and ministry draft decrees in társadalmi egyeztetés on kormany.hu with stated comment deadlines — typically weeks to months ahead of gazette publication, with EUR-Lex NIM supplying the EU-directive-to-Hungarian-act join. The main constraints are engineering and legal rather than availability: no official API or bulk export exists on either primary source, so the pipeline rests on URL-pattern scraping plus PDF extraction, and automated collection should stay on the state-run NJT rather than the commercial net.jogtar.hu and Arcanum consolidations. Everything binding in this cell is Hungarian-only in practice; no authoritative English consolidation of the financial statutes was found, and no Hungarian PSD3 transposition instrument or national deadline has yet surfaced.
